ECHO — mixed laps: the handicap update uses the full-course elapsed time

Scoring system: ECHO    α (blend factor): 0.25 
Three boats on ECHO 1.000. Alpha and Bravo sail the full course of 2 laps;
Charlie sails 1 lap. Charlie's elapsed time is scaled up to the full course
before correction, and the IS formula works out every boat's performance
from the full-course times too — otherwise Charlie, out for half as long,
would look nearly twice as fast as its handicap and be cut savagely.

Start 12:00:00. alpha = 0.25.

Alpha    2 laps  ET 3600 s                  CT 3600
Bravo    2 laps  ET 3700 s                  CT 3700
Charlie  1 lap   ET 1830 s → × 2 = 3660 s   CT 3660

Σ(1/ET) over the full-course times = 1/3600 + 1/3700 + 1/3660 = 0.000821272
ΣH = 3.000

PI = ΣH ÷ (ET × Σ(1/ET)), new H = H + α × (PI − H), rounded to 3 dp:

Alpha    PI = 3 ÷ (3600 × 0.000821272) = 1.014686   new H = 1.003672 → 1.004
Charlie  PI = 3 ÷ (3660 × 0.000821272) = 0.998052   new H = 0.999513 → 1.000
Bravo    PI = 3 ÷ (3700 × 0.000821272) = 0.987262   new H = 0.996816 → 0.997
